scientific_integrity: Mathematical claims are supported by a self-contained structural and distance proof, exact combinatorial enumeration, and reproducible finite checks; no claim of independent audit or exhaustive priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labeled crown graphs for n>=4 and reconfiguration only among minimum super dominating sets; connected distance statement requires n>=5. Finite reproducibility checks are supportive, not the proof. Earlier unindexed equivalences and specialization of more general colored-token swapping methods remain priority risks.
title: Super domination and exact exchange distances on crown graphs
